notes.title: The Ukraine Games Festival has begun!
notes.notes: [p]The Ukrainian gaming festival is here. And as participants in this celebration, we invite you to join us! To do so, we are offering you an 80% discount on the game about Taras Bulbenko and sunflowers on Mars![/p]

notes.title: Ukraine Games Festival has started!
notes.notes:
One of the most important events of the year in the Ukrainian gaming industry - Ukraine games festival - has started! My very first game, Cosmoodyssey Trip to Mars, is also presented at this event, and the game can be purchased with an 80% discount.

Hurry up!
